summary: An explicit eight-coordinate independent cap-one product law and an exact rank-three Parseval frame of maximum row leverage 1/2 have a positive-measure family of orthogonal-complement fibers whose normalized indefinite quadratic trace satisfies T_z(0)/m(z) >= (2048 sqrt(3)/18513) log(1/(24 delta)) and diverges as delta->0. Thus no universal pointwise or essential-uniform normalized complement-fiber trace bound can replace the original product aggregation. This is not a target-level counterexample: the same full product law is bounded by the completed account03/B16 diffuse-residual theorem with ||p_Q||_infinity <= 4 sqrt(6e).
replacement_interface: Average the complement/heavy coordinates before or jointly with the curved quadratic trace; retain original-coordinate product aggregation or signed oscillatory averaging.
